subject: 970 Fellsway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals continued its multi-session public hearing on the Chapter 40B comprehensive permit application for 970 Fellsway. The board reviewed updates to the transportation impact assessment, parking demand, and civil site layout before voting to continue the hearing to March 26, 2024.

items.title: Comprehensive Permit: 970 Fellsway (Case 40B-2023-01)
items.summary: The applicant presented a supplemental traffic impact assessment, updated parking demand figures, and revised civil site circulation plans for the proposed 289-unit residential project, after which the board took public comment and voted to continue the hearing to March 26, 2024.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Staff and board members briefly coordinated scheduling and deferred the approval of pending meeting minutes to a future session.
